The average raider of the Wraiths is little more than an exile with a scavenged SMG, a knife, and a hatred of Nomad clans. Nevertheless, they can pose a nominal threat when in numbers and never go out alone anyway.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Wraiths).

description.value: Throwing hands, does not ignore half armor.

Some companies put their mission statement right there in their name. Budget Arms is, obviously, all about value for money, an approach epitomized by the Guillotine. One burst is enough to mow down any non-armored target. Its cheap plastic edging might throw you off, but hey – anyone looking to kill in style wouldn't touch anything "budget" with a stranger's cyberhand anyway.

Cost: 100eb (Premium)

Class: Poor Quality Heavy SMG • Skill: Handgun • Range: SMG

Damage: 3d6 • Capacity: 45 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (SMG 3), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No (While unfolded)

Slots: 1 • Attachments: Folding Structure, Power Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: Can only load Basic Ammunition. If used for Autofire more than twice in a row, this weapon is Destroyed Beyond Repair. This weapon’s Folding Structure only renders the weapon Concealable while it is not currently loaded with any type of Magazine (Thus requiring a Reload Action to load it before it can be fired after unfolding).

Range: SMG
Pre-installed: Folding Structure, Power Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (SMG 3), Suppressive Fire

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).

Cost: Half (Round Up) the original weapon’s Cost ♦ Availability: Price Category is unchanged

“We live in dangerous times. Violence is rampant, so everyone needs a way to defend themselves. Sadly, many can’t afford effective problem-solvers, which is where bootlegs come to save the day. Yeah, customizing ‘em is a pain and they fall apart easier, but look at that price tag!”

An Ironfake Variant Weapon becomes Exotic if it was not already so, is reduced to Poor Quality, and all of its BODY requirements (if any) are increased by 1 (e.g., BODY 10+ to not jam is now BODY 11+ to not jam). If the weapon was already Poor Quality, its Ironfake Variant now jams when rolling any 1 during the Attack Check (i.e., not negated by Fumble Recovery) and when it malfunctions, it requires an additional Action to clear the malfunction. An Ironfake Weapon cannot be bought using the CEMK’s rule of purchasing it at double its Cost to source it without a Fixer.

Exotic Poor Quality Heavy Pistol. Holds 12 rounds. When making an Aimed Shot, it deals 1d6 additional damage (4d6).

Variant of: Constitutional Arms Unity
Class: Exotic Poor Quality Heavy Pistol
Range: Pistol
